THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460)
AS AMENDED BY THE LAND ACQUISITION
(AMENDMENT) ACT, No. 28 OF 1964
Notice under Section 7
Reference No.: NE/3/1/8/Acquisition/111/44. Land and land Ministry Reference No.: 4/3/12/2011/

CEB/35. I hereby give notice under Sub-section (1) of Section 7 of the Land Acquisition Act, as amended by the Land Acquisition (Amendment) Act, No. 28 of 1964 that the Government intends to acquire Description of the Land to be acquired.

Allotment of land called in Total extent about 0.0619 Hectare described as Lot 01 in Preliminary Plan No. P. P. Nu 2997 of 22.07.2015 prepared by the Surveyor General situated in Talawakele Village in Dimbula Korale Minor Division in Nuwara-eliya Divisional Secretary's Division Nuwara-eliya District and bounded as follows.
Lot No. 1
Name of Land: Talawakele Estate; Details: Garden, Permanent Building and Contains Part of Permanent Building; Claimant: Sri Lanka Railway Department; Extent: About 0.0619 Hectare.

All persons interested in the aforesaid land is to be acquired are hereby required to appear personally or by agents duly authorized in writing, before me at the Divisional Secretariat at Nuwaraeliya 05th day of November, 2015 at 11.15 a.m. relevant to each lots as

stated below and are hereby requested to notify to me in writing (in duplicate) on or before the 30th day of October 2015. The nature of their interests in the land The particulars of their claims for compensation for the acquisition of the said land the amount of compensation and the details of the computation of such amount.
S. P. K. BODHIMANNA, Divisional Secretary, Nuwara Eliya.
Divisional Secretariat, Nuwaraeliya, 01st October, 2015.
